svg.text: Use wish + past perfect to express regret
I wish I had asked more questions.
For regret about a completed past event, use
wish + had + past participle. I wish I had
asked means I did not ask; it cannot change
A: Did you ask about the deadline?
B: No. I wish I had asked more questions.
A: What would you do differently next time?
B: Prepare a list beforehand so I do not
Express regret: You did not save the file.
Model: I wish I had saved the file before
